g.text: No preset names or credential modes.
Reject invalid header tokens and CR/LF values.
Show errors only on the affected row.
Never attach the debug snapshot to:
Do not replay the event POST after disconnect.
- Do not persist values in Session or events
- Later edits affect only the next execution
- Recognize credential fields by the backend contract
- Tool execute receives recognized credential values
- Missing required values fail before outbound call
- Logs and errors show presence only
